text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — we've confirmed an onboarding interruption affecting tenants provisioned between Mar 10–12 due to an auth token rotation bug. I pulled an impacted list into Notion and tagged high-touch accounts. Will share a customer-facing message + credit offer draft in a few. Ping me ASAP for any accounts that need priority outreach.

samir_se: Thanks Maria — can we get a single canonical outbound we can personalize? Need: short apology, root cause in plain terms, what we did, ETA for full recovery, compensation, office-hours invite, and a survey link.

jess_engineer: Patch started rolling out EU at 16:42 UTC (eu-redwood-01). US rollout is in progress. Root cause: KMS-triggered token refresh invalidated some edge auth caches during a tight window; clients saw 401s during retry. Fix: avoid aggressive cache eviction on rotation + backfill tokens for affected sessions. Monitoring shows error rate dropping.

opsbot: incident: deploy eu-redwood-01 finished; status=partial_success; error_rate=0.6% -> continuing monitor.

ryan_csm: Draft outbound looks good — keep it concise. High-touch customers want concrete compensation and an option for 1:1 troubleshooting.

maria_cs: Posting the customer draft below — quick review please, aiming to send segmented emails by COB. Also scheduling a live enablement session for affected onboarding teams: Thu 15:00 PT (recording will be available). Feedback survey link included.

```
Hi <Customer name>,

We’re sorry — you may have experienced onboarding interruptions between Mar 10–12 while we rotated auth tokens.

What happened (short): a token rotation caused a small percentage of sessions to see 401s while caches were refreshed.
What we did: rolled a patch to stop aggressive cache eviction, backfilled affected tokens, and monitored cluster health.
Current status: rollout in progress; most customers recovered within minutes after the patch.
Compensation: we’ll apply a one-time onboarding credit (prorated) to affected accounts and offer 2 hours of live enablement with our solutions team.
Next steps: join our live office hours Thu 15:00 PT (link below); reply to this email or contact support@redwood.ai for 1:1 help.

Thanks for your patience — we’re committed to preventing this going forward.

— Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

jess_engineer: Also add KB + FAQ link about token rotation: https://internal.redwood/kb/token-rotation and include this quick remediation curl for customers doing self-troubleshoot: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>"`

laura_prod: +1 to the curl snippet, add PS: if you continue to see 401s please rotate client-side tokens or clear local cache as our KB describes. I'll confirm the credit automation flow (ledger id and adjustment script).

samir_se: I’ll own segmentation and send cadence: high-touch customers get personalized email + 1:1 invite; mid-tier get templated email + office-hours invite; self-serve customers get an inline notice and KB links. Sending draft by 17:30.

maria_cs: Action items: @samir_se send outbound segmented by tier, @jess_engineer attach KB and remediation script, @laura_prod confirm credit ledger and automation. I’ll coordinate the enablement session and post the office-hours link in the outbound. Tracking thread -> #cs-incident-tracker. Final customer comm to be posted in #customer-comms by 18:00. :thumbsup:

opsbot: support-batch created id=9987; will attach credit adjustment ledger once @laura_prod confirms.

ryan_csm: Thanks team — will follow up with a list of flagged renewal-risk customers who might need exec outreach.

maria_cs: Perfect — let’s reconvene in 30m if any blockers.
